items.title: Line
items.help: Line — Draws straight line segments.  [LINE, L]

items.title: Polyline
items.help: Polyline — Draws a 2D polyline of line and arc segments.  [PLINE, PL]

items.title: Circle
items.help: Circle — Draws a circle (center/radius, diameter, 2P, 3P, tangent-tangent-radius, tangent-tangent-tangent).  [CIRCLE, C]

items.title: Arc
items.help: Arc — Draws an arc (3 points, start-center-end, start-end-radius, center-start-angle, continue).  [ARC, A]

items.title: Rectangle
items.help: Rectangle — Draws a rectangular polyline (optionally filleted or chamfered).  [RECTANG, REC, RECTANGLE]

items.title: Polygon
items.help: Polygon — Draws an equilateral closed polyline.  [POLYGON, POL]

items.title: Ellipse
items.help: Ellipse — Draws an ellipse or elliptical arc.  [ELLIPSE, EL]

items.title: Spline
items.help: Spline — Draws a smooth curve through fit points, or by control vertices (Method CV, Degree 1-5).  [SPLINE, SPL]

items.title: Hatch
items.help: Hatch — Fills an enclosed area or selected objects with a hatch pattern or solid fill.  [HATCH, H, BHATCH, BH]

items.title: Move
items.help: Move — Moves objects a specified distance in a specified direction.  [MOVE, M]

items.title: Copy
items.help: Copy — Copies objects (multiple copies, or a linear array).  [COPY, CO, CP]

items.title: Rotate
items.help: Rotate — Rotates objects around a base point.  [ROTATE, RO]

items.title: Mirror
items.help: Mirror — Creates a mirrored copy of objects.  [MIRROR, MI]

items.title: Scale
items.help: Scale — Enlarges or reduces objects around a base point.  [SCALE, SC]

items.title: Stretch
items.help: Stretch — Stretches objects crossed by a window; objects fully inside are moved.  [STRETCH, S]

items.title: Trim
items.help: Trim — Trims objects at cutting edges (all objects are cutting edges by default).  [TRIM, TR]

items.title: Extend
items.help: Extend — Extends objects to meet boundary edges (all objects by default).  [EXTEND, EX]

items.title: Offset
items.help: Offset — Creates parallel copies of lines, arcs, circles and polylines.  [OFFSET, O]

items.title: Fillet
items.help: Fillet — Rounds the corner between two objects (radius 0 = sharp corner).  [FILLET, F]

items.title: Chamfer
items.help: Chamfer — Bevels the corner between two lines (distance or length/angle method).  [CHAMFER, CHA]

items.title: Array
items.help: Array — Creates copies of objects in a rectangular, polar or path pattern.  [ARRAY, AR]

items.title: Explode
items.help: Explode — Breaks compound objects (polylines, blocks, hatches, dimensions) into their parts.  [EXPLODE, X]

items.title: Erase
items.help: Erase — Removes objects from the drawing.  [ERASE, E, DELETE]

items.title: Join
items.help: Join — Joins lines, arcs and polylines at their end points.  [JOIN, J]

items.title: Break
items.help: Break — Breaks an object between two points.  [BREAK, BR]

items.help: Layer States Manager (LAYERSTATE)

items.title: Quick Select
items.help: Quick Select dialog (QSELECTDIALOG)

items.title: Match Props
items.help: Match Props — Applies the properties of a source object to other objects.  [MATCHPROP, MA, PAINTER]

items.title: Similar
items.help: Similar — Selects all objects similar to the selected ones (type, plus the properties in SELECTSIMILARMODE).  [SELECTSIMILAR, SELSIM]

items.title: Properties
items.help: Show the Properties panel

items.title: More
items.help: Selection tools: QSELECT, invert, by layer/type, chain, filter, named sets

items.title: Group
items.help: Group — Creates and manages named groups (Create/Add/Remove/Explode/REName/List); picking a member selects the group (PICKSTYLE).  [GROUP, G, -GROUP]

items.title: Ungroup
items.help: Ungroup — Dissolves the groups of the selected objects.  [UNGROUP, UNG]

items.title: Isolate
items.help: Isolate — Temporarily hides every object except the selected ones (on the current level for building elements).  [ISOLATEOBJECTS, ISOLATEOBJ, ISOLATE]

items.title: Hide
items.help: Hide — Temporarily hides the selected objects (kept with the drawing until UNISOLATEOBJECTS).  [HIDEOBJECTS, HIDEOBJ]

items.title: End Isolation
items.help: End Isolation — Shows all objects hidden by HIDEOBJECTS or ISOLATEOBJECTS.  [UNISOLATEOBJECTS, UNISOLATE, UNHIDE, ENDISOLATION]

items.help: More drawing and construction tools

items.help: More modify, clipboard and selection tools

items.help: Layer tools (LAYISO, LAYFRZ, LAYMRG…)

items.title: Import File
items.help: Import File — Imports a file by extension: .archi, .dxf, .ifc, .svg, .obj, .stl, .3mf, .geojson, .csv/.txt/.xyz points.  [IMPORTFILE, FILEIMPORT, IMPORTANY]

items.title: IFC
items.help: IFC — Imports an IFC (IFC2x3/IFC4) model: walls, slabs, columns, beams, doors, windows and spaces become BIM elements; other products become meshes.  [IFCIMPORT, IFCIN, -IFCIMPORT]

items.title: SVG
items.help: SVG — Imports SVG paths, lines, polylines, polygons, circles, ellipses, rectangles and text as drawing entities.  [SVGIMPORT, SVGIN, -SVGIMPORT]

items.title: Mesh (OBJ/STL)
items.help: Mesh (OBJ/STL) — Imports an OBJ, STL, 3MF, glTF/GLB, PLY, OFF, AMF or COLLADA (.dae) file as mesh solids (choose the file's units where the format has none).  [MESHIMPORT, OBJIMPORT, STLIMPORT, 3MFIMPORT, OBJIN, STLIN, GLTFIMPORT, GLBIMPORT, PLYIMPORT, OFFIMPORT, AMFIMPORT, DAEIMPORT, COLLADAIMPORT]

items.title: GeoJSON
items.help: GeoJSON — Imports GeoJSON features (WGS84 lon/lat are projected around the project location; projected metres are used as-is).  [GEOJSONIMPORT, GEOJSONIN]

items.title: Points (CSV)
items.help: Points (CSV) — Imports survey points from CSV/TSV/TXT (X,Y[,Z][,name] with or without header, or P,N,E,Z,D).  [POINTSIMPORT, CSVPOINTS, PTIMPORT, IMPORTPOINTS]

items.title: Insert Block
items.help: Insert Block — Inserts a block reference (scale, rotation, attributes).  [INSERT, I, -INSERT, DDINSERT]

items.title: Create Block
items.help: Create Block — Creates a block definition from selected objects.  [BLOCK, B, -BLOCK, BMAKE]

items.title: Xref
items.help: Xref — External references: list, Attach/Overlay a drawing (.archi/.dxf), Reload, Unload, Detach, Bind, Path, Notify (changed files).  [XREF, XR, -XREF, EXTERNALREFERENCES, ERHIGHLIGHT]

items.title: Image
items.help: Image — Places a raster image reference (path, insertion point, width, rotation).  [IMAGEATTACH, IAT, IMAGE]

items.title: Attribute
items.help: Attribute — Defines an attribute (modes Invisible/Constant/Verify/Preset/Lock, tag, prompt, default) to include in a block.  [ATTDEF, ATT, -ATTDEF]

items.title: Paste Special
items.help: Paste Special — Pastes the clipboard at its original coordinates.  [PASTEORIG]

items.title: Tool Palettes
items.help: Blocks, components and tools; drag onto the drawing (TOOLPALETTES)

items.title: Materials
items.help: Material library browser (MATBROWSER)

items.help: Place furniture and fixtures
items.helpUnavailable: Components are not available in this build

items.title: GeoJSON
items.help: GeoJSON — Exports 2D entities (selection or all) as GeoJSON in WGS84 or local metres.  [GEOJSONEXPORT, GEOJSONOUT]

items.title: Points
items.help: Points — Writes point entities (selection or all) to CSV: name,x,y,z,code,layer.  [POINTSEXPORT, PTEXPORT, EXPORTPOINTS]

items.title: 3MF
items.help: 3MF — Exports the 3D model as a 3MF package (millimetres, one object per element).  [EXPORT3MF, 3MFOUT, 3MFEXPORT]

items.title: USDZ
items.help: USDZ — Exports the 3D model as USD: .usda text or .usdz package (UsdPreviewSurface materials).  [USDEXPORT, USDZEXPORT, USDAEXPORT, USDZOUT, USDOUT]

items.title: DXF R12
items.help: DXF R12 — Writes a DXF R12 (AC1009) file for older CAD/CAM software (splines, ellipses, hatches and MText are converted).  [DXFR12OUT, DXFOUTR12, SAVEASR12, DXF12]

items.title: Blocks
items.help: Block and attribute tools

items.title: Exchange
items.help: More import/export formats and file commands

items.title: Import Image
items.help: Import Image — Inserts a PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/TIFF/WebP image at its pixel aspect ratio; with a world file (.pgw/.jgw/.tfw/.wld) it is georeferenced (world units WORLDUNITMM, local origin GEOORIGIN).  [IMAGEIMPORT, IMPORTIMAGE, RASTERIMPORT, GEOIMAGE]

items.title: Scale Image
items.help: Scale Image — Calibrates an image: pick two points on it and enter their real distance; the image is scaled about the first point.  [IMAGESCALE, SCALEIMAGE, IMAGECALIBRATE, CALIBRATE]

items.title: KML / KMZ Out
items.help: KML / KMZ Out — Exports KML or KMZ placed at the project location (GEOGRAPHICLOCATION / project latitude, longitude, north angle): extruded walls, slabs, roofs and rooms by level, linework by layer; KMZ also carries the 3D model (COLLADA).  [KMLOUT, KMZOUT, KMLEXPORT, KMZEXPORT, GOOGLEEARTH]

items.title: Layered SVG Out
items.help: Layered SVG Out — Exports the current level's plan as SVG with one group (Inkscape/Illustrator layer) per drawing layer.  [SVGLAYERSOUT, SVGOUTLAYERS, SVGEXPORTLAYERS, LAYEREDSVG]

items.title: Load .pat Patterns
items.help: Load .pat Patterns — Loads hatch patterns from an AutoCAD .pat file into the drawing (saved with it).  [PATLOAD, HATCHPATLOAD, LOADPAT]

items.title: Block Library
items.help: Browse folders of drawings as a block library with thumbnails; drag a block onto the drawing (BLOCKLIBRARY)

items.title: Text
items.help: Text — Creates single-line text objects.  [TEXT, DT, DTEXT]

items.title: MText
items.help: MText — Creates paragraph (multiline) text inside a width.  [MTEXT, MT, T]

items.title: Linear
items.help: Linear — Creates a horizontal, vertical or rotated linear dimension.  [DIMLINEAR, DLI, DIMLIN]

items.title: Aligned
items.help: Aligned — Creates a dimension aligned with its extension line origins.  [DIMALIGNED, DAL, DIMALI]

items.title: Angular
items.help: Angular — Dimensions the angle between lines, of an arc, or of three points.  [DIMANGULAR, DAN, DIMANG]

items.title: Radius
items.help: Radius — Dimensions the radius of an arc or circle.  [DIMRADIUS, DRA, DIMRAD]

items.title: Diameter
items.help: Diameter — Dimensions the diameter of a circle or arc.  [DIMDIAMETER, DDI, DIMDIA]

items.title: Leader
items.help: Leader — Creates a leader line with annotation text.  [LEADER, LE, LEAD, QLEADER]

items.title: Table
items.help: Table — Inserts an empty table.  [TABLE, TB]

items.title: Dims
items.help: Baseline, continue, ordinate, QDIM, dimension editing

items.title: Text
items.help: Text editing, spelling, fields, tables, symbols

items.title: Constrain
items.help: Geometric and dimensional constraints

items.title: Show Constraints
items.help: Show or hide constraint glyphs in the plan (CONSTRAINTBAR)

items.title: Wall
items.help: Wall — Draws a chain of joined walls (thickness, height, justification, type, arcs).  [WALL, WA]

items.title: Door
items.help: Door — Places doors in walls (default 900×2100).  [DOOR, DOORS]

items.title: Window
items.help: Window — Places windows in walls (default 1200×1200, sill 900).  [WINDOW, WIN]

items.title: Opening
items.help: Opening — Cuts empty openings in walls.  [OPENING, WALLOPENING]

items.title: Curtain Wall
items.help: Curtain Wall — Draws glazed curtain walls with mullion grids.  [CURTAINWALL, CW, CURTAIN]

items.title: Column
items.help: Column — Places structural columns (rectangular or round); Grids places one at every grid intersection, hosted so it follows the grids.  [COLUMN, COLUMNS]

items.title: Beam
items.help: Beam — Draws structural beams between points, or between picked columns (Columns: top of beam at the column tops).  [BEAM]

items.title: Slab
items.help: Slab — Creates a floor slab from points, a closed object or the walls around a point.  [SLAB, FLOOR, SB]

items.title: Roof
items.help: Roof — Creates a flat, shed, gable or hip roof from a footprint.  [ROOF, RF]

items.title: Ceiling
items.help: Ceiling — Creates a ceiling from points, a closed object or the walls around a point.  [CEILING, CEIL]

items.title: Stair
items.help: Stair — Creates straight, L, U or spiral stairs between levels (width, rise or top level, risers, tread, landings).  [STAIR, STAIRS]

items.title: Railing
items.help: Railing — Draws a railing along a path, or on both sides of a Stair's flights (sloped, following the stair).  [RAILING, RAIL]

items.title: Ramp
items.help: Ramp — Creates a sloped ramp (straight or along a path with turns), with landings between flights; warns above 1:12.  [RAMP]

items.title: Foundation
items.help: Foundation — Creates strip footings under walls, isolated footings under columns, or pads from points.  [FOUNDATION, FOOTING, FNDN]

items.title: Slab Slope
items.help: Slab Slope — Slopes a slab by a slope arrow (low point, high point, rise) or angle; Flat resets.  [SLABSLOPE, SLOPEARROW, SLOPE]

items.title: Curtain Grid
items.help: Curtain Grid — Edits a curtain wall grid: add/remove grid lines, panels (glass, solid, spandrel, louvre, empty, door, double door), mullion types, uniform spacing.  [CWGRID, CURTAINGRID]

items.title: Niche
items.help: Niche — Cuts a recess of a given depth into one face of a wall.  [NICHE, RECESS]

items.title: Wall Sweep
items.help: Wall Sweep — Adds cornices, skirting boards or string courses along wall faces, Reveals (grooves cut into the faces), or removes them.  [WALLSWEEP, SWEEPWALL, CORNICE, SKIRTING]

items.title: Room
items.help: Room — Places rooms bounded by walls (pick inside) or by points; reports area.  [ROOM, SPACE, RM]

items.title: Grid
items.help: Grid — Places structural grid lines (straight, Arc through 3 points or Multi-segment), auto-labelled 1,2,3 (vertical) and A,B,C (horizontal).  [GRID, GRIDLINE, GR]

items.title: Room Separator
items.help: Room Separator — Draws room separation lines (virtual room boundaries used by ROOM, SLAB Walls, ROOMUPDATE).  [ROOMSEPARATOR, ROOMSEP, RSL]

items.title: Update Rooms
items.help: Update Rooms — Recomputes the boundaries and areas of rooms placed by picking, after walls or separation lines changed.  [ROOMUPDATE, UPDATEROOMS, RU]

items.title: Area Plan
items.help: Area Plan — Creates area plan boundaries (Gross, Rentable or custom schemes) and reports totals per scheme.  [AREAPLAN, AREABOUNDARY, GROSSAREA]

items.title: Room Bounding
items.help: Room Bounding — Sets whether walls, curtain walls and columns bound rooms (used by ROOM, ROOMUPDATE and SLAB Walls).  [ROOMBOUNDING, ROOMBOUND, RBOUND]

items.title: Tag
items.help: Tag — Tags a door, window, room or element with a live label (mark, type, name, area, keynote…).  [TAG, TAGBYCATEGORY, ELEMENTTAG]

items.title: Tag All
items.help: Tag All — Tags every untagged door, window and/or room on the current level.  [TAGALL, TAGALLNOTTAGGED]

items.title: Keynote
items.help: Keynote — Keynotes: define keys, assign them to elements with a keynote tag, and place a keynote legend table.  [KEYNOTE, KN]

items.title: Marks
items.help: Marks — Renumbers door and window marks per level in reading order (D01…, W01…), or sets a mark.  [MARKS, RENUMBER, NUMBEROPENINGS]

items.title: Section
items.help: Section — Places a section line (A–A…) in plan; section views and sheets use the current section.  [SECTION, SECTIONLINE, SECTIONMARK]

items.title: Draw View
items.help: Draw View — Places an elevation or section of the model as a 2D drawing (with level heads and grid bubbles) in model space.  [VIEWDRAW, DRAWINGVIEW, SECTIONVIEW, ELEVATIONVIEW]

items.title: Update Views
items.help: Update Views — Regenerates all placed elevation/section drawing views from the current model.  [VIEWUPDATE, UPDATEVIEWS]

items.title: Interior Elev.
items.help: Interior Elev. — Places a 4-way interior elevation marker in a room and draws its four interior elevations (A–D).  [INTERIORELEV, INTERIORELEVATION, IELEV, ROOMELEVATIONS]

items.title: Callout
items.help: Callout — Draws a callout (boundary, leader and numbered bubble) in plan and places the enlarged detail view it refers to.  [CALLOUT, DETAILCALLOUT, CALL]

items.help: More BIM tools

items.help: Place furniture and fixtures

items.title: Quick Building
items.help: Quick Building — Quick massing: a rectangle becomes walls, floor slabs and a roof on one or more storeys; Mass turns 3D solids (conceptual masses) into mass floors or walls/floors/roofs by face.  [BUILDING, MASS, QUICKBUILDING]

items.title: Systems
items.help: BIM data, structure, MEP and site tools

items.title: Levels
items.help: Open the Levels panel

items.title: Box
items.help: Box — Creates a 3D solid box (on the face under the first corner when DUCS is on).  [BOX]

items.title: Extrude
items.help: Extrude — Extrudes closed 2D objects into 3D solids: height, Direction (oblique), Path, Taper angle, Both sides (symmetric).  [EXTRUDE, EXT]

items.title: Cylinder
items.help: Cylinder — Creates a 3D solid cylinder: centre, 3P, 2P or Elliptical base; height, 2Point or Axis endpoint.  [CYLINDER, CYL]

items.title: Cone
items.help: Cone — Creates a 3D solid cone or frustum.  [CONE]

items.title: Sphere
items.help: Sphere — Creates a 3D solid sphere.  [SPHERE]

items.title: Revolve
items.help: Revolve — Revolves closed 2D objects about an axis into 3D solids (associative: the solid regenerates when the profile is edited; DELOBJ 1 deletes profiles).  [REVOLVE, REV]

items.title: Press/Pull
items.help: Press/Pull — Extrudes the area around a picked point (with islands as holes), a closed object, or changes an extrusion's height.  [PRESSPULL, PP, PUSHPULL]

items.title: Loft
items.help: Loft — Creates a solid through closed cross-sections at given heights (in selection order).  [LOFT]

items.title: Sweep
items.help: Sweep — Sweeps closed profiles along a path (profile X to the left of travel, Y up).  [SWEEP]

items.title: Pipe
items.help: Pipe — Creates a round pipe (optionally hollow) along a path.  [PIPE, TUBE]

items.title: Shell
items.help: Shell — Hollows boxes and extrusions to a wall thickness, optionally removing the top face (SOLIDEDIT Shell).  [SHELL, SOLIDSHELL, HOLLOW]

items.title: Smooth Mesh
items.help: Smooth Mesh — Smooths solids and meshes by Loop subdivision (1–4 levels).  [MESHSMOOTH, SMOOTHMESH, SUBDIVIDE, MESHREFINE]

items.title: Union
items.help: Union — Combines selected 3D solids into one.  [UNION, UNI]

items.title: Subtract
items.help: Subtract — Subtracts solids from other solids.  [SUBTRACT, SU]

items.title: Intersect
items.help: Intersect — Keeps only the common volume of the selected solids.  [INTERSECT, INTERSECTSOLIDS]

items.title: Slice
items.help: Slice — Cuts solids with a vertical plane through two points or a horizontal plane (XY) at a height.  [SLICE, SL3D]

items.title: Interfere
items.help: Interfere — Finds overlapping volumes between two sets of solids and can create them as new solids.  [INTERFERE, INF, CLASH]

items.title: 3D Mirror
items.help: 3D Mirror — Mirrors solids about the XY, YZ or ZX plane through a point, or a vertical plane through two points.  [MIRROR3D, 3DMIRROR]

items.title: 3D Rotate
items.help: 3D Rotate — Rotates solids about an axis parallel to X, Y or Z through a point.  [ROTATE3D, 3DROTATE]

items.title: 3D Array
items.help: 3D Array — Creates rectangular (rows × columns × levels) or polar 3D arrays of objects.  [3DARRAY, ARRAY3D, 3A]

items.title: Topography
items.help: Topography — Creates a toposurface from points (with elevations), contour polylines (picked, or every object on contour Layers of an imported DXF), an XYZ/CSV file or typed x,y,z values.  [TOPO, TOPOSURFACE, TERRAIN]

items.title: Contours
items.help: Contours — Sets the contour interval and major-line spacing of toposurfaces (0 = hide contours).  [CONTOURS, CONTOUR]

items.title: Building Pad
items.help: Building Pad — Levels a toposurface inside a boundary to a pad elevation (cut and fill).  [BUILDINGPAD, SITEPAD]

items.title: Surfaces
items.help: Ruled, tabulated, revolved and edge surfaces; mesh repair

items.title: Node Editor
items.help: Visual node editor with live preview (NODEEDITOR)

items.title: Distance
items.help: Distance — Measures the distance and angle between two points.  [DIST, DI]

items.title: Area
items.help: Area — Calculates area and perimeter of points or objects (with Add/Subtract).  [AREA, AA]

items.title: List
items.help: List — Lists the properties of selected objects.  [LIST, LI, LS]

items.title: ID Point
items.help: ID Point — Displays the coordinates of a location.  [ID]

items.title: Mass Props
items.help: Mass Props — Reports area, perimeter, centroid, bounding box and volume of objects.  [MASSPROP]

items.title: Count
items.help: Count — Counts objects by type, block and element type (selection or whole drawing).  [COUNT]

items.title: Takeoff
items.help: Takeoff — Quantity takeoff: wall areas/volumes (net of openings) per type and material, slabs, roofs, columns, beams, door/window counts; optional CSV.  [TAKEOFF, QTO, QUANTITIES]

items.title: Cost Estimate
items.help: Cost Estimate — Cost estimate from the takeoff and unit rates (UNITPRICE drawing rates or a JSON table); optional CSV.  [COSTESTIMATE, COST, ESTIMATE]

items.title: Unit Prices
items.help: Unit Prices — Stores a unit rate in the drawing (COST:<category>[:<type>]:<measure>) used by COSTESTIMATE.  [UNITPRICE, COSTRATE, RATE]

items.title: Room Schedule
items.help: Room Schedule — Room area schedule with net (minus columns) and gross (to wall centre lines) areas, perimeter and volume; optional CSV.  [ROOMSCHEDULE, ROOMAREAS, AREASCHEDULE]

items.title: Clash Detect
items.help: Clash Detect — Finds hard clashes between elements and 3D solids (touching and hosted/joined elements are ignored); lists, selects and zooms.  [CLASHDETECT, CLASHES, CLASHTEST]

items.title: Check Model
items.help: Check Model — Checks the model: walls without height, openings wider than or outside their host, overlapping/duplicate walls and rooms, unnamed or duplicate rooms, missing levels.  [CHECKMODEL, MODELCHECK, AUDITMODEL, BIMAUDIT]

items.title: Sun Position
items.help: Sun Position — Sun azimuth/altitude, sunrise and sunset for a date, time and the project location; stores SUNAZIMUTH/SUNALTITUDE.  [SUNPOSITION, SUNPOS, SUNCALC]

items.title: Accessibility
items.help: Accessibility — Accessibility check: door clear widths (A11YDOORWIDTH, default 850 mm) and Ø1500 mm wheelchair turning circles in bathrooms clear of fixtures (A11YTURNING).  [ACCESSIBILITY, A11Y, ACCESSCHECK, ADACHECK]

items.title: Egress
items.help: Egress — Egress check: longest walking distance from each room to the nearest exit (exterior or exit=1 doors, stairs on upper levels) around walls and columns, against the limit (EGRESSMAX, m). Draws the routes on EGRESS-ROUTES.  [EGRESS, TRAVELDISTANCE, ESCAPEROUTES, EGRESSCHECK]

items.title: Energy Balance
items.help: Energy Balance — Seasonal heating energy balance: losses from degree days (latitude table or HDD), solar gains per window orientation, internal gains, utilisation factor; optional CSV.  [ENERGYBALANCE, HEATINGNEED, ENERGYNEED, SOLARGAINS]

items.title: Bill of Quantities
items.help: Bill of Quantities — Bill of quantities: takeoff items priced with unit rates (UNITPRICE rates or a JSON table), numbered by trade with subtotals, contingency (BOQCONTINGENCY %) and VAT (BOQVAT %); CSV or XLSX.  [BOQ, BILLOFQUANTITIES, BILLQ]

items.title: Takeoff by Phase
items.help: Takeoff by Phase — Quantity takeoff split by construction phase (new work and demolition) and level; optional CSV.  [TAKEOFFPHASE, QTOPHASE, PHASEQUANTITIES, TAKEOFFLEVEL]

items.title: Lighting Schedule
items.help: Lighting Schedule — Lighting fixture schedule (mark, type, level, room, position, rotation, lm, W, K) and average illuminance per room.  [LIGHTSCHEDULE, FIXTURESCHEDULE, LIGHTINGSCHEDULE, LUX]

items.title: Fire Compartments
items.help: Fire Compartments — Fire compartments: room areas grouped by prop fireCompartment (else per level) against FIREMAXAREA (doubled with FIRESPRINKLERS=1), and walls between compartments below FIRERATINGREQ minutes; selects failing walls.  [FIRECOMPARTMENTS, FIRECHECK, COMPARTMENTS]

items.title: Load Takedown
items.help: Load Takedown — Structural load takedown per column: tributary slab areas, dead (self weight + LOADSDL) and imposed loads by room usage, accumulated down the stacked columns, ULS 1.35G+1.5Q, SLS and axial stress; optional CSV.  [LOADTAKEDOWN, TAKEDOWN, COLUMNLOADS]

items.title: Parking Check
items.help: Parking Check — Parking provision check: required spaces from room usage and area (PARKINGRULES, e.g. office=35;apartment=unit:1) against the parking spaces placed, including accessible spaces.  [PARKINGCHECK, PARKINGCOUNT, PARKINGREQ]

items.title: Rainwater
items.help: Rainwater — Rainwater from roofs: plan area incl. overhangs, runoff coefficient, design flow Q = C·i·A, downpipes (EN 12056-3 capacities), gutter length and annual harvest; optional CSV.  [RAINWATER, RAINCALC, DOWNPIPES]

items.title: Angle Between
items.help: Angle Between — Angle between two lines (or vertex + two points).  [ANGLEBETWEEN, ANGBETWEEN, LINEANGLE]

items.title: Distance to Object
items.help: Distance to Object — Shortest distance from a point to an object.  [DISTTOOBJECT, DISTOBJ, DISTTOENTITY]

items.title: Point Inside?
items.help: Point Inside? — Tells whether a point is inside, outside or on a closed contour (polyline, circle, ellipse, hatch, room, slab).  [POINTINSIDE, INSIDECHECK, PTINSIDE]

items.title: Total Length
items.help: Total Length — Total length of the selected lines, arcs, circles, polylines, splines and ellipses (and wall lengths).  [TLEN, TOTALLENGTH, TOTLEN]

items.title: Measure 3D
items.help: Pick two points on the 3D model to measure distance, ΔX/ΔY/ΔZ (MEASURE3D)

items.title: More
items.help: Energy, daylight, acoustics, carbon and code checks

items.title: Markups
items.help: Markup and comment manager: add, reply, resolve, zoom to (MARKUP)

items.title: Compare
items.help: Compare this drawing with another version and show the differences as an overlay (COMPARE)

items.title: BCF Import
items.help: BCF Import — Imports BCF 2.x topics (.bcfzip) as markups: comments, status, viewpoint camera and selection mapped to elements by IFC GlobalId.  [BCFIN, BCFIMPORT, IMPORTBCF]

items.title: BCF Export
items.help: BCF Export — Exports the markups as BCF 2.1 topics (.bcfzip) with comments, status, camera and selected elements by IFC GlobalId.  [BCFOUT, BCFEXPORT, EXPORTBCF]

items.title: Revision Stamp
items.help: Revision Stamp — Revision stamps: a numbered revision triangle, or a new row in the revision table; advances the drawing revision (REVNUMBER).  [REVSTAMP, REVTRIANGLE, REVTAG, REVISION]

items.title: Issue Tracker
items.help: Issue Tracker — Issue tracker stored in the drawing: Add (linked to the selection), List, Show, Status, Assign, Priority, Comment, Zoom, Delete and Csv export.  [ISSUETRACKER, ISSUELIST, TRACKISSUES]

items.title: Versions
items.help: Versions — Version history saved next to the drawing: Save a named checkpoint, List, Restore a version (undoable), Diff two versions (or a version and the current drawing), Delete, Prune.  [VERSIONS, CHECKPOINT, DOCVERSIONS, VERSIONHISTORY]

items.title: Merge Models
items.help: Merge Models — Three-way merge: combines another branch of the drawing (theirs) into this one using their common ancestor (base); non-conflicting changes of both sides are kept, conflicts keep ours and are listed.  [MODELMERGE, MERGE3, MERGEBRANCH]

items.title: Office Standards
items.help: Office Standards — Office standards package (.archistd): Export this drawing's layers, linetypes, styles, materials, types, view templates and hatch patterns; Import (add, optionally overwrite); Check deviations.  [STANDARDS, STANDARDSPACKAGE, OFFICESTANDARDS]

items.title: Change Journal
items.help: Change Journal — Change journal for crash recovery: On (record every change every n seconds to the recovery folder), Off, Now (record immediately), Status.  [JOURNAL, AUTOSAVEJOURNAL, CHANGEJOURNAL]

items.title: Recover File
items.help: Recover File — Opens a damaged .archi drawing, repairing it: truncated files are closed after the last complete object, undecodable objects and settings are dropped, and the model is audited.  [RECOVER, RECOVERFILE, OPENRECOVER]

items.title: Recovery Files
items.help: Recovery Files — Lists the autosave copies and change journals left by a crash or forced quit, and opens one (Open n) or deletes them (Clear).  [RECOVERYFILES, JOURNALRECOVERY, RECOVERJOURNAL]

items.title: Share
items.help: Share the project and a PDF with Mail, Messages, AirDrop… (SHARE)

items.title: eTransmit
items.help: eTransmit — Packs the drawing with its referenced images, material textures and external references (paths rewritten) and a transmittal report into a ZIP.  [ETRANSMIT, PACKANDGO, TRANSMIT, ARCHIVEPACKAGE]

items.title: Share…
items.help: Share… — Shares the drawing through the macOS share sheet (Mail, Messages, AirDrop, Notes…): Project (.archi), Pdf of the drawing or active sheet, or Both.  [SHARE, SHAREDRAWING, SENDTO]

items.title: Exchange Check
items.help: Exchange Check — Checks the gbXML or COBie export (or a given file) against the schema's required elements, enumerations and references.  [EXCHANGECHECK, GBXMLCHECK, COBIECHECK, VALIDATEEXPORT]

items.title: Batch Jobs
items.help: Batch Jobs — Runs a JSON batch job file over many drawings: open/import, command lines or a script, outputs in any export format, analysis reports and save (the open drawing is not changed).  [BATCH, BATCHJOBS, SCRIPTPRO, RUNBATCH]

items.title: IFC Options
items.help: IFC Options — IFC export settings saved in the drawing: schema (IFC2X3 Coordination View 2.0, IFC4 or IFC4X3), model view definition (ReferenceView = tessellated or DesignTransferView), base quantities (Qto_*) and georeferencing (IfcMapConversion).  [IFCOPTIONS, IFCEXPORTOPTIONS, IFCSETTINGS]
